scope: Part O controlled fixtures only; no production writes, deployment, browser, or native-device run

priorProductionObservation.source: Delegated prior-phase observation, not independently remeasured
priorProductionObservation.limitation: Single-image timing cannot establish a multi-image concurrency benefit

sameBaselineHarness.implementation: Actual cloudinaryService.ts with mocked Firebase, Android Platform flag, FormData, and fetch

before.source: Delegated measured baseline before this change

isolatedPairedControl.before: Sequential calls to actual uploadImageToCloudinary using the same 4-image 100ms transport fixture
isolatedPairedControl.after: Actual uploadMultipleImages bounded scheduler using the same fixture
isolatedPairedControl.interpretation: Sequential scheduling adds about 200ms to this controlled critical path; max-two scheduling removes one of two serial upload waves

safety: No more than two complete read/validate/upload operations in flight
Results retain input order; progress counts acknowledged completions
First observed failure halts scheduling; both workers settle before rollback
Rollback includes acknowledged late successes and pins cleanup identity across token awaits
Unknown outcomes are not retried or assigned invented cleanup identifiers
Existing 401 single-refresh retry, actual Blob size/MIME validation, native Blob close, and storage/quality policy retained
No equipment submission or ambiguous-commit behavior changed
caveat: These are deterministic latency fixtures, not real Android upload or memory measurements. Real-device speed and throughput benefit remain unproven; shared bandwidth and native memory behavior may limit improvement.
